name: Ironleaf 4: Evaluation
description: Data analyst (project 7): runs 19 test questions, compares the assistant's numbers with reference SQL and saves the scores.

parameters.jsCode:
// The test set: questions a gym manager would ask, each with reference SQL written by hand using the
// same definitions the assistant is given (active member, churn, revenue, last week...).
const W = "date_trunc('week', current_date) - interval '7 days'", W1 = "date_trunc('week', current_date)";
const LM = "date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month'", TM = "date_trunc('month', current_date)";
const ACTIVE = "m.joined_on <= current_date AND (m.cancelled_on IS NULL OR m.cancelled_on > current_date)";
const Q = [
  ['Q01', 'How many active members do we have?', `SELECT count(*)::int AS active_members FROM members m WHERE ${ACTIVE}`],
  ['Q02', 'How many active members are on each plan?', `SELECT p.name AS plan, count(*)::int AS active_members FROM members m JOIN plans p ON p.id = m.plan_id WHERE ${ACTIVE} GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC`],
  ['Q03', 'Which branch lost the most members last month?', `SELECT b.name AS branch, count(*)::int AS cancellations FROM members m JOIN branches b ON b.id = m.branch_id WHERE m.cancelled_on >= ${LM} AND m.cancelled_on < ${TM} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1`],
  ['Q04', 'How many new members joined in January this year?', `SELECT count(*)::int AS new_members FROM members WHERE joined_on >= date_trunc('year', current_date) AND joined_on < date_trunc('year', current_date) + interval '1 month'`],
  ['Q05', 'What was our total revenue last month?', `SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_on >= ${LM} AND paid_on < ${TM}`],
  ['Q06', 'Show revenue by branch for last month.', `SELECT b.name AS branch, round(sum(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN members m ON m.id = p.member_id JOIN branches b ON b.id = m.branch_id WHERE p.status = 'paid' AND p.paid_on >= ${LM} AND p.paid_on < ${TM} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY 2 DESC`],
  ['Q07', 'What was the monthly churn rate at Salford Quays for each of the last 6 full months?', `SELECT d::date AS month, round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM members m WHERE m.branch_id = 3 AND m.cancelled_on >= d AND m.cancelled_on < d + interval '1 month') / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM members m WHERE m.branch_id = 3 AND m.joined_on <= d AND (m.cancelled_on IS NULL OR m.cancelled_on > d)), 0), 1) AS churn_rate_pct FROM generate_series(${TM} - interval '6 months', ${TM} - interval '1 month', interval '1 month') d ORDER BY 1`],
  ['Q08', 'What was the most common cancellation reason in the last 3 months?', `SELECT cancel_reason, count(*)::int AS cancellations FROM members WHERE cancelled_on >= ${TM} - interval '3 months' AND cancelled_on < ${TM} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1`],
  ['Q09', 'How many members have cancelled because they moved to a competitor?', `SELECT count(*)::int AS members FROM members WHERE cancel_reason = 'moved to a competitor'`],
  ['Q10', 'How many check-ins did Stockport have last week?', `SELECT count(*)::int AS check_ins FROM visits v JOIN branches b ON b.id = v.branch_id WHERE b.name = 'Stockport' AND v.checked_in_at >= ${W} AND v.checked_in_at < ${W1}`],
  ['Q11', 'Which branch had the most check-ins last week?', `SELECT b.name AS branch, count(*)::int AS check_ins FROM visits v JOIN branches b ON b.id = v.branch_id WHERE v.checked_in_at >= ${W} AND v.checked_in_at < ${W1} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1`],
  ['Q12', 'What were the 3 busiest hours of the day for check-ins over the last 30 days?', `SELECT extract(hour FROM checked_in_at)::int AS hour, count(*)::int AS check_ins FROM visits WHERE checked_in_at >= current_date - 30 AND checked_in_at < current_date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3`],
  ['Q13', 'Which class type has the highest no-show rate?', `SELECT c.class_type, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE bk.status = 'no_show') / count(*) FILTER (WHERE bk.status <> 'cancelled'), 1) AS no_show_rate_pct FROM bookings bk JOIN classes c ON c.id = bk.class_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1`],
  ['Q14', 'What was the average fill rate of Spin classes in the last 30 days?', `SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM bookings bk JOIN classes c ON c.id = bk.class_id WHERE c.class_type = 'Spin' AND c.starts_at >= current_date - 30 AND c.starts_at < current_date AND bk.status <> 'cancelled') / (SELECT sum(capacity) FROM classes c WHERE c.class_type = 'Spin' AND c.starts_at >= current_date - 30 AND c.starts_at < current_date), 1) AS fill_rate_pct`],
  ['Q15', 'How many failed payments were there at Didsbury last week?', `SELECT count(*)::int AS failed_payments FROM payments p JOIN members m ON m.id = p.member_id JOIN branches b ON b.id = m.branch_id WHERE b.name = 'Didsbury' AND p.status = 'failed' AND p.paid_on >= ${W} AND p.paid_on < ${W1}`],
  ['Q16', 'What share of new members in the last 90 days came from referrals?', `SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE source = 'referral') / count(*), 1) AS referral_share_pct FROM members WHERE joined_on >= current_date - 90 AND joined_on < current_date`],
  ['Q17', 'How many active Premium members are there at Altrincham?', `SELECT count(*)::int AS members FROM members m JOIN plans p ON p.id = m.plan_id JOIN branches b ON b.id = m.branch_id WHERE p.name = 'Premium' AND b.name = 'Altrincham' AND ${ACTIVE}`],
  ['Q18', 'Show revenue by month for the last 6 full months.', `SELECT date_trunc('month', paid_on)::date AS month, round(sum(amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_on >= ${TM} - interval '6 months' AND paid_on < ${TM} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1`],
  ['Q19', 'How many members joined at each branch in the last 30 days?', `SELECT b.name AS branch, count(*)::int AS new_members FROM members m JOIN branches b ON b.id = m.branch_id WHERE m.joined_on >= current_date - 30 AND m.joined_on < current_date GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY 2 DESC`]
];
return Q.map(([qid, question, sql]) => ({ json: { qid, question, sql, sql_b64: Buffer.from(sql, 'utf8').toString('base64'), session_id: 'eval-' + qid, history: '[]' } }));

// One question per item for the assistant (no chat history).
return $('Questions').all().map(i => ({ json: { question: i.json.question, session_id: i.json.session_id, history: '[]' } }));

parameters.content:
## Ironleaf 4: Evaluation (manual)
19 questions a manager would ask, each with reference SQL written by hand using the same definitions the assistant gets. Each question goes through the real assistant (**Ironleaf 1**), and **Compare** passes it only if every value in the reference result appears in the assistant's result (numbers within 0.6% for rounding). Results go to **Ironleaf Eval**, with the SQL the assistant wrote.
